Subject: Realtime streams from our integration are halting in prod

Monica,

We started seeing user-facing failures around 08:50 PDT. The app shows long hangs (>8s) and then the websocket connection closes with a 1006 on the client. This is consistently reproducible from our east-coast fleet and affects ~12% of requests over the last 30m.

Attached is a short client-side capture and our logs indicating repeated chunk gaps. Can you triage? This is blocking a major demo tomorrow.

- Jack

1) Collect server-side http traces and the proxy (ingress) logs for 08:30-09:10 PDT.
2) Check for recent routing changes / configuration pushes (LB / edge proxies) in us-east.
3) If client side is ruled out, immediate mitigation = route Clearport to a reserved pool and ramp keepalive to 15s.

We need a short executive summary for Vivek in 2 hours if this is a production incident that remains unresolved. Jack is running a demo tomorrow; this is time-sensitive.

Elliot Price

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jack Tully <jack.tully@clearport.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Realtime streams from our integration are halting in prod

Elliot / team — initial findings from the first pass on INF-4789:
- Pattern: intermittent websocket write stalls from the edge proxy to the serving runtime; client sees delayed chunk arrival, then connection reset. p95 token latency jumped from ~120ms to ~2.3s during the incident window.
- Root signals: increased queue depth and sporadic thread scheduling delays on the proxy instances serving the edge (us-east-1). No obvious model runtime OOMs or worker crashes.
- Hypothesis: transient proxy throttling/backpressure combined with a keepalive setting mismatch causes client disconnects (the proxy is closing idle streams earlier than the client keepalive).

Actions taken:
- Collected server traces and the attached capture (clearport-logs-20270923.tar.gz).
- Increased proxy keepalive threshold from 5s -> 15s as an experiment on a small canary of traffic (still monitoring).
- Opened INF-4789 and linked traces: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4789

Next steps: if the canary looks good, we will route Clearport traffic to a reserved pool and apply the keepalive change globally for their traffic. Karthik, can you provision the reserved pool and prepare a rollback plan?

Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jack Tully <jack.tully@clearport.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Realtime streams from our integration are halting in prod

Quick update — warroom ran and mitigation is in place: 
- Provisioned a small dedicated pool for Clearport and started traffic migration (routing rule rolled at 08:40 PDT).
- Keepalive increased to 15s on the proxy canary; no new 1006s observed on the canary nodes after 20m.
- Implemented temporary rate-smoothing on the ingress to reduce microbursts that appear to trigger queue growth.

Logs and trace captures uploaded to the Drive link above. Please note: we still see elevated p95 for long requests during peak bursts; the mitigation reduced error rate from ~12% -> ~1.8% in the last hour.

For execs: requires coordination to approve a temporary capacity reservation for Clearport (estimated cost impact: $5k/week) if they continue to run high bursts. Also recommend a short postmortem to harden proxy backpressure behavior.

Karthik Iyer
Principal SRE

From: Elliot Price <elliot_price@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jack Tully <jack.tully@clearport.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 11:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Executive summary: Clearport realtime connection halts — mitigation and ask

Vivek — FYI / action requested. Short summary of the incident and current status: 
- Impact: Clearport observed websocket connection halts and client 1006 disconnects on us-east hosted API. Peak error rate ~12% (09/20 08:30-09:10 PDT) affecting production users and a scheduled demo.
- Cause (current hypothesis): transient edge proxy backpressure + keepalive mismatch causing early stream closures. No model runtime failures found.
- Mitigation completed: routed Clearport to a dedicated pool; increased proxy keepalive to 15s; added ingress rate smoothing. Error rate reduced to ~1.8%.
- Artifacts: logs and traces uploaded (clearport-logs-20270923.tar.gz), ticket INF-4789, trace link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4789

Ask: please approve (A) an emergency temporary capacity reservation for Clearport (estimated $5k/week) while we monitor for 72 hours, and (B) a customer goodwill credit (~30% of September hosting invoice) to offset the demo impact if Clearport requests one. We will follow with a formal postmortem and corrective plan for proxy backpressure handling.

If you approve, we will notify Clearport and create a billing note.

Thanks,
Elliot Price
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
